Oneliner

Lilium-1 CubeSat’s mission is focus on demonstrate image PAT operation and IoT S&F operation.
Description

IRIS-E CubeSat mission is focus on validating accurate image acquisition and fast image transmission capabilities for space-based point-acquire-transmit (PAT) operation and verifying and validating space internet of thing techniques for store-and-forward (S&F) operation.
Results

Operating almost flawlessly.
